results.title: Phl spikers sustain form, crush Tunisia
results.description: Alas Pilipinas Girls moved closer to the FIVB U17 Volleyball World Championship Round of 16 after sweeping Tunisia, with Xyz Rayco and Resty Olaguir rediscovering their connection to help the Philippines improve to 2-1 in Pool B.

results.title: Aces rest A'ja Wilson, Chelsea Gray and Jackie Young after brutal back-to-back travel
results.description: Without A’ja Wilson, Chelsea Gray and Jackie Young, the Las Vegas Aces were no match for the New York Liberty, losing 111-71.

results.title: Enzo Maresca expects Rodri back in Manchester next week amid transfer rumours
results.description: City this week rejected a 45 million euro (£38.5million) offer from Barcelona for the Ballon d’Or winner, with Real Madrid also reportedly interested.

results.title: Why Braves ace Chris Sale was ejected from Sunday's game
results.description: The Braves ace woke up Sunday morning still seething over a balk call, so he let the umpires know and was ejected before first pitch.

results.title: Don Nelson, second-winningest NBA coach who won 5 titles as a Celtics player, dies at 86
results.description: Don Nelson, the second-winningest coach in NBA history who won five championships as a player with the Boston Celtics, died Sunday. He was 86.
